Entry requirements · 2027 entry

History BA at University of Oxford

What University of Oxford asks of applicants to History BA for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Oxford courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 1 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with US qualifications (Oxford’s AAA level): three APs at grade 5 (including any subjects the course requires) plus ACT 31+ or SAT 1460+ — or four APs at grade 5 with no SAT/ACT
  • Optional ACT/SAT essay not required
  • No superscoring:
    • SAT sections from one sitting
    • ACT Highest Full Battery score only

History’s standard offer is AAA; Oxford’s page sets the AP and SAT/ACT levels by the course’s A-level offer. Oxford’s international qualifications page lists these under “USA” as Advanced Placement qualifications with or without the SAT/ACT; it does not mention the US high-school diploma itself. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026University of Oxford: International qualifications
English language
  • Higher level English language requirement (all Oxford courses)
  • IELTS (Academic recommended; IELTS Online not accepted): 7.5 overall, minimum 7.0 per component
  • TOEFL iBT: 110 overall (Listening 22, Reading 24, Speaking 25, Writing 24) — only tests taken up to and including 20 January 2026 are accepted
  • PTE Academic: 76 overall, minimum 66 in Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing
  • C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency:
    • 191 overall, minimum 185 per component
    • Oxford Test of English (Advanced): 165, minimum 155 per component
  • All component scores from a single test session (no superscoring)
  • Not needed if English is your first language and you have always been a resident and citizen of a majority English-speaking country recognised by UKVI

Evidence is not needed at application; offer holders must meet the requirement by 31 July of the year of the offer. TOEFL tests taken from 21 January 2026 are not accepted while the new format is under review. Other accepted qualifications (e.g. Trinity ISE, GCSE/IGCSE English, IB English B at HL 7) and exemptions (e.g. an English-taught IB) are listed on the English language page. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement:
    • four APs at grade 5, or three APs at grade 5 plus ACT 31+ or SAT 1460+ (Oxford’s AAA level)
    • the APs must include any subjects the course requires
  • AP Calculus AB and BC cannot count as two separate subjects
  • Not accepted: associate degrees, CLEP, GED, dual enrolment

Oxford’s international qualifications page lists these under “USA” as Advanced Placement qualifications with or without the SAT/ACT; it does not mention the US high-school diploma itself. AP Seminar and AP Research (AP Capstone) are not a condition of any offer. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026University of Oxford: International qualifications
Other requirements
  • Written work: one argument-driven history essay from normal school work (max 2,000 words) with a signed certificate — deadline 10 November 2026
  • No admissions test
  • Shortlisted candidates are invited to at least one online interview, expected in December; they may discuss their written work and personal statement and be asked to read and discuss a short passage
